summary: Gold X2 Mining Inc., a NYSE American/TSXV-listed gold developer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 11, 2026 news release confirming completion of its previously announced purchase of 42 unpatented mineral claims near Thunder Bay, Ontario, from Bold Ventures Inc. Consideration comprised C$500,000 cash, 150,000 Gold X2 common shares, and a 2% NSR royalty on Canadian critical minerals excluding copper, with Gold X2 entitled to repurchase half (1%) for C$1,000,000. No board recommendation or advisor named; claims carry an existing 3% NSR, half buyable for C$2.5 million. Watch integration into the Moss Gold Project and royalty overhang.
